rules.quote: Use an initial capital letter for medical terms only if the term is a proper noun or adjective, or if it is the name of a genus.

rules.quote: If it is a disease named after people who had the disease, use the possessive case.

rules.quote: Always refer to organisations in the same way as they refer to themselves.

rules.quote: Be mindful of outdated language that can perpetuate stigma or misunderstandings about the condition.

when: Applies to condition terminology that has become outdated as research and social understanding evolve.

rules.why: G-1: extract the outdated-terminology check from the broad inclusive-language section, separately from person-labelling and paired-name formatting.
